description: Starfighter on a hilltop at Bayraktepe in Hendek, wearing the code 4-733. The International F-104 Society states that this code is fake and that the airframe is an unidentified CF-104; the genuine 63-12733 is in İstanbul. tail_number is therefore deliberately blank. Esri World Imagery examined September 2026 shows a light-coloured aircraft-shaped object beside the hilltop buildings.
